export default {

    methods: {
        async getProducts() {
            await fetch('https://dummyjson.com/products')
                .then((res) => res.json())
                .then((data) => (this.products = data.products))
        }
    },
    async mounted() {
        await this.getProducts()
    }
}
</script>
